bio.text: Andrew Gounardes, a Democrat, is a member of the New York State Senate representing District 26 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026, according to Ballotpedia.
He was first elected to the Senate in 2018, defeating the incumbent in what was then District 22.
He earned a B.A. in political science from Hunter College in 2006 and a J.D. from the George Washington University School of Law in 2010.
His earlier career included work as an attorney, as counsel to the Brooklyn borough president and as director of external affairs for the Citizens Committee for New York City.
